programStack.complexTextStateTurnProbe: Search below the successful long TextState turn's observed cursor high-water until the candidate reports a program-data-stack failure after an allocation/copy event and a completed helper return. This is an empirical unwind probe, not an independent capacity oracle. Caller output must remain unchanged and request state must return to its entry mark.

stringWorkload.backendScope: interpreter and owning O0/O2 use the same String VerifiedIrProgram/body; ABI3 runs the separate fixed-only program
limits: UTF-8 byte preservation is required (report 265); unpaired surrogates are rejected at the boundary because they have no UTF-8 form.
String conformance does not claim ABI3 String parity, memory reduction, cache locality, or throughput improvement.
List, async, and effectful String operations remain outside this slice.
stringWorkload.report265Utf8Transition: Owning Strings are UTF-8 since report 265. Every String oracle in this workload was re-derived by an independent script from the unchanged logical texts (byte counts, extents, offsets, serialized bytes, and the string.length Int outputs, which are now UTF-8 byte counts). The isolated-surrogate edge cases and round trips became boundary-rejection inputs; the joined pair and the dynamic-concat capacity probe use two 2-byte scalars, keeping every extent.

emptyRecord.abi3Boundary: ABI3 represents Empty as one retained node and zero bytes; the owning-stack candidate uses an eight-byte token extent.
emptyRecord.sourceBoundary: The Flow parser rejects zero-field records; this type is supplied in the compiler lowering context for a verified IR conformance case.

scopeShadow.body: Compiler-minted IR stores an Envelope local, enters Scope, stores a narrower Leaf into the same logical LocalSlot, leaves Scope, and returns the restored Envelope.
scopeShadow.sourceBoundary: The Flow source syntax does not expose LocalSlot rebinding; this is compiler-verified IR, and the runner inspects slot identity and scope entry/exit shapes.

flowLocalDropSemantics: drop(left) and drop(right) consume descriptors loaded from immutable locals; the logical local bindings remain in scope until exercise exits. directTopDupDrop tests an actual top-of-stack dup followed by drop.

stableArenaOracle.layoutPolicy: The fixed-only and String-bearing owning-stack programs both use descriptor-based stable arena lowering.
stableArenaOracle.uniqueLivePayloadAccounting: unavailable unless the backend supplies exact interval-union evidence
stableArenaOracle.occupiedCursorAccounting: peak and final cursor are reported from native execution; a live result may retain dead bytes beneath it

payload.report265Utf8Transition: Post-execution correction (report 265): owning_stack_runtime_test.c reported 41 after its String builders moved to UTF-8; it was 42 under UTF-16. The value was taken from the native run, not derived independently; the reserved (8-byte aligned) peaks are unchanged.

stableArenaCapacityControl.n8FailureNote: Report 280: with scalars in registers all eight exercises fit 448 bytes; the first rejected reservation is the 24-byte post-exercise tail that reaches the 464-byte peak.

owningStack.turnBoundarySemantics: Turn 2 receives a State independently decoded from turn 1 raw caller-owned retained bytes through the Value-list API; this tests publication round-trip across the host boundary, not persistent native controller storage.
owningStack.emptyRecordConformanceBoundary: Empty is inserted into the compiler lowering context because Flow currently rejects zero-field record declarations; its verified constructor and body are still compiler-produced.
owningStack.repetitionPeakInvariant: N=1 and N=8 have the same maximum nested call depth; report each observed absolute peak cursor because retained dead interior space can differ with the unrolled call count
owningStack.copyAccounting: Report descriptor-transfer metadata separately from DeepCopyBytes, MoveBytes, InputCopyBytes, and RetainedCopyBytes; construction and the 16-byte explicit Envelope dup per mailbox.exercise are permitted deep-copy lower-bound categories.

programStack.capacitySelection: one byte below the successful direct dup/drop body's observed high-water; report that value rather than treating it as an independent absolute peak oracle

Re-derived numbers: NonEmptyString constructor payload 12->10, nested record payload 22->19, resultStringError and nestedError deep copy 24->16, owner-range literal deep copy 80->56 (temporary-in-scope 32 + after-scope 24), stable binding literal 20/24->14/16 with deep copy 16, dead-only post-rewind allocation payload 10->9; nominalIntConformance and positiveIdConformance images included. limits: Synchronous execution only; no async provider buffers or cancellation claims.

Fixture coverage is bounded to fixed Int/Bool/Unit workloads, selected enums and UTF-16 String cases, nominal/refined scalar cases, and selected acyclic nested record/Option/Result shapes; it does not establish general type or layout coverage.
Call-depth boundary is checked with a generated static acyclic function chain because verified IR rejects recursive call graphs.
Candidate Value input/output marshaling is host-owned and reported separately.
No final memory-policy, cache-locality, or throughput claim.
